title: Falco Bridge: Add a stream index field
description:
Add a unique, consecutive fd ID similar to TCP and UDP. Find useful HF
IDs once. Other miscellaneous cleanups.

Fixes #20538

notes.body:
added 1 commit
  • 91d8c572 - Falco Bridge: Add a stream index field
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/19867/diffs?diff_id=1360540669&start_sha=e68eed90ca6995b0826f78cd010bf545fc4679ca)
It's for future expansion. I was thinking it might be useful to have a conversation-/endpoint-style dialog that shows file descriptor activity. Otherwise we could just cast the index to a pointer.

changes_data.diff:
@@ -33,6 +33,9 @@ The following changes have been made since version 0.9.1:
 
 * Cloudtrail log messages can now be viewed as formatted JSON data.
 
+* The system call dissector now has a "falcobridge.fd.stream" field, which provides a unique number for each file descriptor.
+  The "Follow File Descriptor Stream" feature now uses this field to track streams. wsbuglink:20538[]
+
 * We now ship universal macOS installers instead of separate packages
 for Arm64 and Intel. wsbuglink:17294[]
